subject.title: feat(plugins): upgrade llm_input/llm_output hooks from fire-and-forget to modifying

question: Should OpenClaw preserve `llm_input` and `llm_output` as observation-only hooks and add capability-specific interception APIs, or redefine the shipped hooks despite runner capability differences?
rationale: This changes a public plugin contract and the authority, latency, failure behavior, and supported semantics of every model runner; code review cannot safely choose that permanent product boundary.

options.title: Add capability-specific interception
options.body: Keep the existing observation hooks stable and add explicitly named block/transform hooks whose fields are limited to what each supported runner can enforce.

options.title: Narrow and complete this upgrade
options.body: Remove unsupported cross-runner fields and claims, repair every supported consumer and validation path, and document the intentional compatibility change before merge.

options.title: Pause the API change
options.body: Defer or close this PR if maintainers do not want core to own the compatibility, security, latency, and availability costs of general model interception.

recommendation.title: Add capability-specific interception
recommendation.body: Keep the existing observation hooks stable and add explicitly named block/transform hooks whose fields are limited to what each supported runner can enforce.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history spans both the plugin contract and agent runtime surfaces needed for this decision.
